title: Warm Roasted Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Tunisian dish featuring roasted lamb, plum jam, and aromatic spices, served in a stone bowl, perfect for a comforting meal. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is also a great hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, and ground coriander.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the plum jam to the pot, stirring to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid, then transfer it to the preheated oven and roast for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven, then stir in any accumulated juices.
Serve the lamb tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired, in a stone bowl.
